sentences.japanese: 私は、毎秋りんご園へ行くのが楽しみだ。
sentences.english: I delight in going to the apple orchard each fall.

sentences.japanese: 創造論者の中には、アダムとイブにへそはなくエデンの園の木には年輪がなかったと信じる人もいる。
sentences.english: Some creationists believe that Adam and Eve had no navels, and that the trees in the Garden of Eden had no growth rings.
